brief: 5 morning rituals that changed how I run my business.

slots.headline: Morning Rituals That Changed How I Run My Business

slots.title: No Phone Rule
slots.body: I keep my phone off until 9 AM. This protects my first hour for deep thinking. Clarity compounds faster than notifications.

slots.title: Cold Water Reset
slots.body: A two-minute cold shower shocks my nervous system awake. It trains my mind to embrace discomfort early. Decisions feel lighter all day.

slots.title: Single Priority Block
slots.body: I calendar one three-hour block for my hardest task. No meetings, no Slack, just focused execution. Everything else waits patiently.

slots.title: Movement Before Email
slots.body: Twenty minutes of stretching or walking clears mental cobwebs. Physical momentum creates psychological momentum. I arrive at my desk ready.

slots.title: Journal One Truth
slots.body: I write three lines on what actually matters today. This cuts through the noise of urgent requests. Intention replaces reactivity.

slots.title: Tea And Presence
slots.body: I brew loose-leaf tea and breathe for five minutes. The ritual signals my brain that work begins. Calm is my first profit.
